title: Measurement of Intracellular Ca2+ Concentration
author: Mengchen Shi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kcgcstw

steps.title: Seed Cells
steps.instruction: Seed cells at a density of 10^2 cells onto a confocal culture dish.

steps.title: Load Cells with Rhod-2 AM
steps.instruction: Load the cells with Rhod-2 AM fluorophore (2 μM) and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µl of Rhod-2 AM working solution.
Incubate in a 5% CO2 humidified incubator at 37℃ for 20 min.

steps.title: Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the cells twice with PBS.

steps.title: Measure Intracellular Calcium
steps.instruction: Evaluate changes in intracellular calcium using a laser scanning confocal microscope (Zeiss LSM 710, Germany).

substeps.instruction: Observe Rhod-2 AM fluorescence at 525 nm excitation (Ex) and 590 nm emission (Em).
